description: NumPy stores and calculates with arrays of numbers. Learn shapes, positions, simple calculations and copies using tiny lists you can understand by hand. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
